label: Congressional Hearings
deltaNote: Sept 9, 2026: Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets held 'Restoring Public Trust Through UAP Transparency and Whistleblower Protection' — its first UAP-focused hearing.

label: AARO Cases Received
contestNote: AARO's FY2025 annual report (released Jul 21, 2026, months late) logged 319 new cases and resolved 114 — 205 remain unresolved. Whistleblowers allege AARO has not been given access to the most classified programs.
deltaNote: FY2025 report (Jun 2024–May 2025): 319 new reports received, including the fiscal year's only maritime case — a ~100-object Navy-reported swarm off Virginia's coast.

label: Public Whistleblowers
contestNote: Grusch, Graves, Fravor, and Herrera testified publicly through mid-2026. Sept 9, 2026: Air Force veterans Jeffrey Nuccetelli and Dylan Borland and active-duty Navy Chief Alexandro Wiggins added sworn testimony before the House Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets — Wiggins the first active-duty Navy witness to testify publicly. Grusch separately claims 40+ additional witnesses provided classified testimony to the ICIG. AARO Historical Report Vol. 1 found 'no evidence' supporting retrieval program claims; Borland told Congress AARO's public position is 'a misrepresentation of the truth.'
deltaNote: Sept 9, 2026 hearing added 3 new sworn public witnesses (Nuccetelli, Borland, Wiggins).

label: UAP Laws Enacted
deltaNote: FY2026 NDAA added 3 new UAP provisions (signed Dec 2025)

label: Presidential Directives
deltaNote: Trump ordered Pentagon to release UAP/alien files (Feb 19, 2026) — first ever presidential UAP disclosure directive. Implemented July 31, 2026 via ODNI guidance waiving NDAs/secrecy oaths for witnesses disclosing through AARO/PURSUE channels.

label: EO Milestone Status
deltaNote: May 20 EO 90-day milestone reached. PURSUE Tranche 2 (64 files: 51 videos, 6 PDFs, 7 audio) released May 22 — two days after the milestone. Next milestone: 300-day full-disclosure-or-justify deadline in late Nov/Dec 2026.

label: PURSUE Files Released
deltaNote: Tranche 4 (Jul 10, 2026, 40 files): 2015 Pantex nuclear-facility drone intrusion, 2019 aviator account, 2025 China-adjacent sightings. Tranche 5 (Aug 7, 2026, 41 files): 2021 Gulf of Oman UAP swarm during a live-fire exercise, 2002 Afghanistan triangle-object account, 2026 FBI infrared footage. Total: 379 files across five tranches; portal has logged 1.7B+ hits since May 8 launch.

label: UAP Science Advisory Council
deltaNote: Formed June 14, 2026 and chaired by Harvard astrophysicist Avi Loeb, tasked by the White House, AARO, ODNI, and FBI to provide scientific guidance to UAP investigations, spanning physics, data science, oceanography, and biology.
